subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the linked fork cleanup PR, replace it with a same-repo cleanup PR, or close that candidate and keep this issue as the canonical bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open linked fork PR already owns the proposed fix path and ClawSweeper should not queue a competing fix until maintainers decide that path.

options.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
options.body: Treat the linked fork PR as the current candidate, then either land it after refresh/proof or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

options.title: Close candidate, keep issue
options.body: Close the linked fork PR if it is not usable, and leave this issue open as the canonical source-reproducible bug for a later fix.

options.title: Defer placeholder cleanup
options.body: Leave both the issue and candidate unresolved if maintainers want to sequence this behind broader Google Chat delivery work.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
recommendation.body: Treat the linked fork PR as the current candidate, then either land it after refresh/proof or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.
